# Tester Exchange

> Free test-for-test exchange that gets Android developers the 12 testers × 14 days Google Play requires
> before a new personal developer account can publish to production. Testers are real people on their own
> phones; a companion Android app verifies each day they opened the app (30+ seconds), and Google reviews
> exactly this engagement. 1 credit = 1 verified tester-day. A 12-tester campaign costs 180 credits, held in
> escrow and refunded if unused. Credits are earned by testing other apps or bought (US$7 / 90, $12 / 180, $14 / 225).

## Bring your own testers (free)
- A developer shares https://testerexchange.com/t/<package> with friends. Friends who sign up there, install the app
  and the Tester Exchange companion app are verified like any tester and fill the 12 seats; no credits move.
  Credits pay only for the seats friends don't fill ("fill from exchange" on /start or /apps).
- MCP tools: get_testers (start here), friends_status, start_friends_test, fill_from_exchange (token).
  agent_call actions: friends, start_friends_test, fill_from_exchange (token).

## Autopilot (how it works now)
- Nobody browses or picks apps. A developer adds their app and adds testerexchange-testers@googlegroups.com to the
  closed track once. Free: link a phone with the Tester Exchange app; it is given apps to test automatically (paid apps
  first) and the credits earned flow into the developer's own test. Free apps get exchange testers while their owner tests.
  Paid: buy credits and skip testing; paid apps get testers before anyone else. Google's 14 days apply to everyone.
- Agents: one MCP tool / action does the whole setup: get_testers (package_name, name?). Call it again to check progress.

## Pages
- Closed testing guide (14 languages): https://testerexchange.com/guide/

## For AI agents
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no OAuth): https://vvrlxzbngxfxddywidoq.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp
  Auth: header `Authorization: Bearer tx_…` or `?token=tx_…`. Public tools (about, platform_stats, pricing) work without a token. Users create tokens at https://testerexchange.com/api
- HTTP API (one endpoint): POST https://vvrlxzbngxfxddywidoq.supabase.co/rest/v1/rpc/agent_call
  headers: `apikey: sb_publishable_OwXT7OfwIGkuIn420mavVA_MsAkzZGf` (public key), `Content-Type: application/json`
  body: {"p_token": "tx_…" | null, "p_action": "help", "p_args": {}}
  Actions: help, stats, pricing (public); get_testers (start here), me, my_apps, add_app, start_campaign, campaign,
  add_testers, set_status, join, my_tests, share_kit, buy_credits (token).
- OpenAPI: https://testerexchange.com/openapi.json
- Agent docs: https://testerexchange.com/agents/
- What an agent can't do: the 14 days of real use on a phone, and paying (checkout needs a human).

## Facts (October 2026)
- Personal Google Play developer accounts created after 13 Nov 2023 need a closed test with at least 12 opted-in
  testers for 14 continuous days, then apply for production access with a questionnaire.
- The requirement was 20 testers until December 2024.
